summary: Completed testing of Engineering Phase 1 flow (DRF accept-assign, generate-drawings, ECR/ECN module). Backend APIs working excellently (94.4% success). Frontend pages load correctly with all key UI elements present.

backend_issues.notes: One test 'failed' because DRF was already in 'in_progress' status from previous test run - this is actually correct API behavior (rejecting re-accept of already accepted DRF). All other backend APIs working perfectly.

frontend_issues.notes: All tested pages load correctly. DRF Inbox shows assigned DRFs with 'Buka Work Group' buttons. All data-testid elements are present and functional.

passed_tests: ✅ Backend: Login authentication for all 3 users (riski, engstaff, salesuser)
✅ Backend: GET /api/drawing-requests/engineering-users - returns engineering users list
✅ Backend: POST /api/drawing-requests/{id}/accept-assign - accepts DRF and assigns engineer
✅ Backend: POST /api/drawing-requests/{id}/generate-drawings - creates 2 drawings sharing ONE BOM
✅ Backend: GET /api/drawings?from_drf_id={id} - filters drawings by DRF
✅ Backend: GET /api/drawings/next-number - preview number generation works
✅ Backend: POST /api/ecn with kind='ecr' - creates ECR with 'ECR-' prefix
✅ Backend: POST /api/ecn with kind='ecn' - creates ECN with 'ECN-' prefix
✅ Backend: GET /api/ecn?kind=ecr - filters ECN by kind
✅ Backend: POST /api/ecn/{id}/submit - changes status from draft to submitted
✅ Backend: POST /api/ecn/{id}/review - eng leader can approve/reject ECN
✅ Backend: Permission check - sales user correctly denied (403) when trying to generate drawings
✅ Frontend: Drawing Request Inbox page loads with DRF list
✅ Frontend: DRF rows show correct status badges and action buttons
✅ Frontend: All data-testid elements present (drf-inbox-list, drf-inbox-row, etc.)
